correctness.summary: Binet bounds reduce the new tail to positivity of an explicit elementary P_T. Directed interval enclosures prove P_212.435>0 on [2.23,15], an analytic sign argument closes x>=15, and the published 2017 parameter comparison propagates the result downward. At x=9 an explicit unique zero gives the upper obstruction.

limitations: The exact transition parameter is not determined.
The endpoint tau=tau_9 is not classified.
The finite-range lower certificate uses interval arithmetic rather than formal proof-assistant verification.
Equivalent later coverage under different notation remains a residual originality risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2017 source proves only tau<=25, gives a tau=1000 counterexample, and labels the interval (212,213) as numerical evidence. Searches of the exact quotient, source title/DOI, critical-parameter terminology, numerical range, and later Gamma-monotonicity literature did not locate a rigorous extension to 212 or a comparable narrow bracket.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The theorem raises the rigorous sufficient endpoint from 25 to 212.435 and confines the transition to an interval shorter than 0.074, converting an earlier numerical observation into a rigorous near-sharp bracket.
